title: Panel Update
description: Updates the panel to the latest version from GitHub. Environment settings, databases, and sites are preserved, and an unhealthy release is rolled back automatically.
toolMissing: The update tool is missing and will be downloaded automatically on first use.
running: The update is running. The panel may restart briefly; keep this page open.
confirmPrompt: The panel will be updated and its service restarted. Confirm?

outcome.successHint: The panel is up to date. Reload the page to pick up the new version.
outcome.failedHint: Inspect the log below; an unhealthy release is rolled back automatically.
